shloka_text: प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां पृथुवक्षा महायशाः । रामः कमलपत्राक्षः पुरोधसमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.109.1 ।।
transliteration: prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ pṛthuvakṣā mahāyaśāḥ | rāmaḥ kamalapatrākṣaḥ purodhasamathābravīt || 7.109.1 ||
translation: प्रभातायां when dawned, तु indeed, शर्वर्यां the night, पृथुवक्षाः broad-chested, महायशाः highly renowned, रामः Rama, कमलपत्राक्षः lotus-eyed, पुरोधसम् to the chief priest, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: When the night had dawned, the broad-chested, highly renowned, lotus-eyed Rama then spoke to his chief priest.
comments: At dawn, all rites performed by Vasishtha, Rama sets forth on his last journey -- silent and clad in fine garments, attended by Sri, Hri and Resolve, by his weapons and the Vedas in embodied form, by the sages, the palace women, his brothers, the ministers and all the people, and by the monkeys, bears and rakshasas -- and every living creature of Ayodhya follows, so that the city is left empty of all that breathes.

shloka_text: अग्निहोत्रं व्रजत्वग्रे दीप्यमानं सह द्विजैः । वाजपेयातपत्रं च शोभमानं महापथे ।। 7.109.2 ।।
transliteration: agnihotraṃ vrajatvagre dīpyamānaṃ saha dvijaiḥ | vājapeyātapatraṃ ca śobhamānaṃ mahāpathe || 7.109.2 ||
translation: अग्निहोत्रं the sacred fire, व्रजतु let it go, अग्रे in front, दीप्यमानं shining, सह with, द्विजैः Brahmins, वाजपेय Vajapeya, आतपत्रं umbrella, च and, शोभमानं splendid, महापथे on the great path.
explanation: He instructed that the shining sacred fire should go in front with the Brahmins, and the splendid Vajapeya umbrella should also be carried on the great path.

shloka_text: ततो वसिष्ठस्तेजस्वी सर्वं निरवशेषतः । चकार विधिवद्धर्मं महाप्रास्थानिकं विधिम् ।। 7.109.3 ।।
transliteration: tato vasiṣṭhastejasvī sarvaṃ niravaśeṣataḥ | cakāra vidhivaddharmaṃ mahāprāsthānikaṃ vidhim || 7.109.3 ||
translation: ततः then, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, तेजस्वी the lustrous, सर्वं all, निरवशेषतः completely, चकार performed, विधिवत् according to scriptural injunctions, धर्मं the ritual, महाप्रास्थानिकं of the great departure, विधिम् rite.
explanation: Then, the lustrous Vasishtha completely performed all the rituals for the great departure according to scriptural injunctions.

shloka_text: ततः सूक्ष्माम्बरधरो ब्रह्ममावर्तयन्परम् । कुशान्गृहीत्वा पाणिभ्यां प्रसज्य प्रययावथ ।। 7.109.4 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sūkṣmāmbaradharo brahmamāvartayanparam | kuśāngṛhītvā pāṇibhyāṃ prasajya prayayāvatha || 7.109.4 ||
translation: ततः then, सूक्ष्माम्बरधरः wearing fine garments, ब्रह्मम् the supreme Brahman (Vedas), आवर्तयन् meditating upon/reciting, परम् supreme, कुशान् Kusa grass, गृहीत्वा having taken, पाणिभ्याम् with both hands, प्रसज्य having spread/placed, प्रययाव went forth, अथ then
explanation: Then, wearing fine garments, meditating upon the supreme Brahman, and holding Kusa grass in his hands, he went forth.

shloka_text: अव्याहरन्क्वचित्किञ्चिन्निश्चेष्टो निःसुखः पथि । निर्जगाम गृहात्तस्माद्दीप्यमान इवांशुमान् ।। 7.109.5 ।।
transliteration: avyāharankvacitkiñcinniśceṣṭo niḥsukhaḥ pathi | nirjagāma gṛhāttasmāddīpyamāna ivāṃśumān || 7.109.5 ||
translation: अव्याहरन् not speaking, क्वचित् anywhere, किञ्चित् anything, निश्चेष्टः motionless/without activity, निःसुखः without joy/devoid of happiness, पथि on the path, निर्जगाम went out, गृहात् from the house, तस्मात् from that, दीप्यमानः shining, इव like, अंशुमान् the sun
explanation: Not speaking anything, motionless, and devoid of joy on the path, he departed from that house, shining like the sun.

shloka_text: रामस्य दक्षिणे पार्श्वे सपद्मा श्रीरपाश्रिता । सव्ये तु ह्रीर्महादेवी व्यवसायस्तथाग्रतः ।। 7.109.6 ।।
transliteration: rāmasya dakṣiṇe pārśve sapadmā śrīrapāśritā | savye tu hrīrmahādevī vyavasāyastathāgrataḥ || 7.109.6 ||
translation: रामस्य of Rama, दक्षिणे on the right, पार्श्वे side, सपद्मा with a lotus, श्रीः Sri (Goddess of prosperity), अपाश्रिता took refuge/was present, सव्ये on the left, तु indeed, ह्रीः Hri (Modesty/Shame), महादेवी great goddess, व्यवसायः determination/resolve, तथा similarly, अग्रतः in front
explanation: On Rama's right side was Sri, the goddess of prosperity, holding a lotus; on his left was the great goddess Hri (Modesty); and in front of him was Determination.

shloka_text: शरा नानाविधाश्चापि धनुरायतमुत्तमम् । तथा ऽ ऽयुधानि ते सर्वे ययुः पुरुषविग्रहाः ।। 7.109.7 ।।
transliteration: śarā nānāvidhāścāpi dhanurāyatamuttamam | tathā ' 'yudhāni te sarve yayuḥ puruṣavigrahāḥ || 7.109.7 ||
translation: शराः arrows, नानाविधाः of various kinds, च and, अपि also, धनुः bow, आयतम् long/stretched, उत्तमम् excellent, तथा similarly, आयुधानि weapons, ते those, सर्वे all, ययुः went, पुरुषविग्रहाः in human form
explanation: Various kinds of arrows, an excellent long bow, and all other weapons followed him, having assumed human forms.

shloka_text: वेदा ब्राह्मणरूपेण गायत्री सर्वरक्षिणी । ओङ्कारो ऽथ वषट्कारः सर्वे राममनुव्रताः ।। 7.109.8 ।।
transliteration: vedā brāhmaṇarūpeṇa gāyatrī sarvarakṣiṇī | oṅkāro 'tha vaṣaṭkāraḥ sarve rāmamanuvratāḥ || 7.109.8 ||
translation: वेदाः the Vedas, ब्राह्मणरूपेण in the form of Brahmins, गायत्री Gayatri mantra, सर्वरक्षिणी protecting all, ओङ्कारः Omkara (the sacred syllable Om), अथ and, वषट्कारः Vasatkara (a ritual exclamation), सर्वे all, राममनुव्रताः followers of Rama/devoted to Rama
explanation: The Vedas in the form of Brahmins, the all-protecting Gayatri mantra, Omkara, and Vasatkara, all followed Rama with devotion.

shloka_text: ऋषयश्च महात्मानः सर्व एव महीसुराः । अन्वगच्छन्महात्मानं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम् ।। 7.109.9 ।।
transliteration: ṛṣayaśca mahātmānaḥ sarva eva mahīsurāḥ | anvagacchanmahātmānaṃ svargadvāramapāvṛtam || 7.109.9 ||
translation: ऋषयः sages, च and, महात्मानः great-souled ones, सर्व all, एव indeed, महीसुराः Brahmins, अन्वगच्छन् followed, महात्मानम् the great-souled one (Rama), स्वर्गद्वारम् to the gate of heaven, अपावृतम् which was open.
explanation: All the great-souled sages and Brahmins followed the great-souled Rama to the open gate of heaven.

shloka_text: तं यान्तमनुगच्छन्ति ह्यन्तःपुरचराः स्त्रियः । सवृद्धबालदासीकाः सवर्षवरकिङ्कराः ।। 7.109.10 ।।
transliteration: taṃ yāntamanugacchanti hyantaḥpuracarāḥ striyaḥ | savṛddhabāladāsīkāḥ savarṣavarakiṅkarāḥ || 7.109.10 ||
translation: तम् him, यान्तम् going, अनुगच्छन्ति followed, हि indeed, अन्तःपुरचराः women of the inner apartments, स्त्रियः women, सवृद्धबालदासीकाः with old and young maidservants, सवर्षवरकिङ्कराः with eunuchs and chief servants.
explanation: The women of the inner apartments, accompanied by their old and young maidservants, eunuchs, and chief servants, followed him as he went.

shloka_text: सान्तःपुरश्च भरतः शत्रुघ्नसहितो ययौ । रामं गतिमुपागम्य साग्निहोत्रमनुव्रतः ।। 7.109.11 ।।
transliteration: sāntaḥpuraśca bharataḥ śatrughnasahito yayau | rāmaṃ gatimupāgamya sāgnihotramanuvrataḥ || 7.109.11 ||
translation: सान्तःपुरः with his inner apartment (women), च and, भरतः Bharata, शत्रुघ्नसहितः accompanied by Shatrughna, ययौ went, रामम् Rama, गतिम् the path/destination, उपागम्य having approached, साग्निहोत्रम् with his sacred fire, अनुव्रतः following (Rama's) vow/path.
explanation: Bharata, accompanied by Shatrughna and the women of his inner apartment, went, following Rama's path and bringing his sacred fire with him.

shloka_text: ते च सर्वे महात्मानः साग्निहोत्राः समागताः । सपुत्रदाराः काकुत्स्थमनुजग्मुर्महामतिम् ।। 7.109.12 ।।
transliteration: te ca sarve mahātmānaḥ sāgnihotrāḥ samāgatāḥ | saputradārāḥ kākutsthamanujagmurmahāmatim || 7.109.12 ||
translation: ते they, च and, सर्वे all, महात्मानः great-souled ones, साग्निहोत्राः with their sacred fires, समागताः assembled, सपुत्रदाराः with their sons and wives, काकुत्स्थम् Kakutstha (Rama), अनुजग्मुः followed, महामतिम् the great-minded one.
explanation: All those great-souled individuals, having assembled with their sacred fires, sons, and wives, followed the great-minded Rama.

shloka_text: मन्त्रिणो भृत्यवर्गाश्च सपुत्रपशुबान्धवाः । सर्वे सहानुगा राममन्वगच्छन्प्रहृष्टवत् ।। 7.109.13 ।।
transliteration: mantriṇo bhṛtyavargāśca saputrapaśubāndhavāḥ | sarve sahānugā rāmamanvagacchanprahṛṣṭavat || 7.109.13 ||
translation: मन्त्रिणः ministers, भृत्यवर्गाः groups of servants, च and, सपुत्रपशुबान्धवाः with their sons, animals, and relatives, सर्वे all, सहानुगाः with their followers, रामम् Rama, अन्वगच्छन् followed, प्रहृष्टवत् joyfully.
explanation: All the ministers and groups of servants, along with their sons, animals, relatives, and followers, joyfully followed Rama.

shloka_text: ततः सर्वाः प्रकृतयो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताः । गच्छन्तमन्वगछंस्तं राघवं गुणरञ्जिताः ।। 7.109.14 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtāḥ | gacchantamanvagachaṃstaṃ rāghavaṃ guṇarañjitāḥ || 7.109.14 ||
translation: ततः then, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः the subjects, हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताः filled with joyful and well-nourished people, गच्छन्तम् going, अन्वगछन् followed, तम् him, राघवं Rama, गुणरञ्जिताः delighted by his virtues.
explanation: Then, all the subjects, filled with joyful and well-nourished people, who were charmed by Rama's virtues, followed him as he departed.

shloka_text: ततः सस्त्रीपुमांसस्ते सपक्षिपशुवाहनाः । राघवस्यानुगाः सर्वे हृष्टा विगतकल्मषाः ।। 7.109.15 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sastrīpumāṃsaste sapakṣipaśuvāhanāḥ | rāghavasyānugāḥ sarve hṛṣṭā vigatakalmaṣāḥ || 7.109.15 ||
translation: ततः then, सस्त्रीपुमांसः with women and men, ते they, सपक्षिपशुवाहनाः with birds, animals, and vehicles, राघवस्य of Rama, अनुगाः followers, सर्वे all, हृष्टाः joyful, विगतकल्मषाः free from sin.
explanation: Then, all of Rama's followers, including men, women, birds, animals, and those with vehicles, were joyful and purified of all sins.

shloka_text: स्नाताः प्रमुदिताः सर्वे हृष्टाः पुष्टाश्च वानराः । दृढं किलकिलाशब्दैः सर्वं राममनुव्रतम् ।। 7.109.16 ।।
transliteration: snātāḥ pramuditāḥ sarve hṛṣṭāḥ puṣṭāśca vānarāḥ | dṛḍhaṃ kilakilāśabdaiḥ sarvaṃ rāmamanuvratam || 7.109.16 ||
translation: स्नाताः bathed, प्रमुदिताः greatly delighted, सर्वे all, हृष्टाः joyful, पुष्टाः well-nourished, च and, वानराः monkeys, दृढं loudly, किलकिलाशब्दैः with shouts of joy, सर्वं all, राममनुव्रतम् devoted to Rama.
explanation: All the monkeys, bathed, greatly delighted, joyful, and well-nourished, loudly cheered with shouts of joy, all devoted to Rama.

shloka_text: न तत्र कश्चिद्दीनो वा व्रीडितो वा ऽपि दुःखितः । हृष्टं समुदितं सर्वं बभूव परमाद्भुतम् ।। 7.109.17 ।।
transliteration: na tatra kaściddīno vā vrīḍito vā 'pi duḥkhitaḥ | hṛṣṭaṃ samuditaṃ sarvaṃ babhūva paramādbhutam || 7.109.17 ||
translation: न not, तत्र there, कश्चित् anyone, दीनः miserable, वा or, व्रीडितः ashamed, वा or, अपि even, दुःखितः sorrowful, हृष्टं joyful, समुदितं prosperous, सर्वं all, बभूव was, परमाद्भुतम् extremely wonderful.
explanation: There was no one miserable, ashamed, or sorrowful; everything was joyful, prosperous, and extremely wonderful.

shloka_text: द्रष्टुकामो ऽथ निर्यान्तं रामं जानपदो जनः । यः प्राप्तः सो ऽपि दृष्ट्वैव स्वर्गायानुगतो मुदा ।। 7.109.18 ।।
transliteration: draṣṭukāmo 'tha niryāntaṃ rāmaṃ jānapado janaḥ | yaḥ prāptaḥ so 'pi dṛṣṭvaiva svargāyānugato mudā || 7.109.18 ||
translation: द्रष्टुकामः desirous of seeing, अथ then, निर्यान्तं departing, रामं Rama, जानपदः rural, जनः people, यः who, प्राप्तः arrived, सः he, अपि even, दृष्ट्वैव having seen immediately, स्वर्गाय to heaven, अनुगतः followed, मुदा with joy.
explanation: Then, any rural person who arrived, desirous of seeing Rama departing, immediately followed him to heaven with joy upon seeing him.

shloka_text: ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि जनाश्च पुरवासिनः । आगच्छन्परया भक्त्या पृष्ठतः सुसमाहिताः ।। 7.109.19 ।।
transliteration: ṛkṣavānararakṣāṃsi janāśca puravāsinaḥ | āgacchanparayā bhaktyā pṛṣṭhataḥ susamāhitāḥ || 7.109.19 ||
translation: ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि bears, monkeys, and rakshasas, जनाः people, च and, पुरवासिनः city-dwellers, आगच्छन् came, परया with supreme, भक्त्या devotion, पृष्ठतः from behind, सुसमाहिताः well-composed.
explanation: Bears, monkeys, rakshasas, and the city-dwellers, all well-composed, followed him from behind with supreme devotion.

shloka_text: यानि भूतानि नगरे ऽप्यन्तर्धानगतानि च । राघवं तान्यनुययुः स्वर्गाय समुपस्थितम् ।। 7.109.20 ।।
transliteration: yāni bhūtāni nagare 'pyantardhānagatāni ca | rāghavaṃ tānyanuyayuḥ svargāya samupasthitam || 7.109.20 ||
translation: यानि which, भूतानि beings, नगरे in the city, अपि even, अन्तर्धानगतानि invisible, च and, राघवं Rama, तानि those, अनुययुः followed, स्वर्गाय for heaven, समुपस्थितम् who was ready to depart.
explanation: Even the invisible beings residing in the city followed Rama, who was ready to depart for heaven.

shloka_text: यानि पश्यन्ति काकुत्स्थं स्थावराणि चराणि च । सर्वाणि रामगमने ह्यनुजग्मुर्हि तान्यपि ।। 7.109.21 ।।
transliteration: yāni paśyanti kākutsthaṃ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | sarvāṇi rāmagamane hyanujagmurhi tānyapi || 7.109.21 ||
translation: यानि which, पश्यन्ति see, काकुत्स्थं Kakutstha (Rama), स्थावराणि immobile beings, चराणि mobile beings, च and, सर्वाणि all, रामगमने at Rama's departure, हि indeed, अनुजग्मुः followed, हि indeed, तानि those, अपि even.
explanation: All beings, both immobile and mobile, that beheld Rama, indeed followed him at his departure.

shloka_text: नोच्छ्वसत्तदयोध्यायां सुसूक्ष्ममपि दृश्यते । तिर्यग्योनिगताश्चापि सर्वे राममनुव्रताः ।। 7.109.22 ।।
transliteration: nocchvasattadayodhyāyāṃ susūkṣmamapi dṛśyate | tiryagyonigatāścāpi sarve rāmamanuvratāḥ || 7.109.22 ||
translation: न not, उच्छ्वसत् breathing, तत् that, अयोध्यायां in Ayodhya, सुसूक्ष्मम् very subtle, अपि even, दृश्यते was seen, तिर्यग्योनिगताः born in lower species, च and, अपि even, सर्वे all, राममनुव्रताः devoted to Rama.
explanation: Not even the slightest breathing creature was seen in Ayodhya, as all beings, even those of lower species, were devoted followers of Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे नवाधिकशततमः सर्गः ।। 109 ।। Thus ends the hundred and ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
